scenarios.upstreamTest: secondary-button pan > pans past five pixels with no context menu
scenarios.notes: The threshold is a SCREEN quantity: 5 px away (dx 3, dy 4) is still a click, 6 px engages the pan. Upstream then pans incrementally from the engage point (the engaging move itself does not move the view; the next move shifts the camera by delta / zoom). pointer.qnt differs on purpose: its hand-tool pan starts on the press with no threshold and keeps the grab world point under the pointer (PanKeepsGrabUnderPointer), and its threshold is DRAG_PX = 4 (squared distance > 16). Replay the threshold expectations (config.dragThresholdPx) against the pointing -> gesture edge; the camera expectations after engagement are an adapter-policy divergence. Context-menu and pointer-broadcast parts of the upstream test are host concerns and are not ported.
